name: Ashiya Mio
source:
Inclination: Smell fetish
Interest: Anything involving moving about
Likes: Shoujo manga

A 3rd year student in the track and field club, a dazzling and energetic sports minded girl.
She is bothered by the size of her chest because it gets in the way of her moving around. Because her chest would grow even more she has no interest in getting pregnant.

She is able to enhance her physical strength. Hypnosis that controls the body is not very effective on her.
